text.p: Datakey Inc said Tuesday that John Underwood, president and chief executive officer, has resigned effective December 31, 1996.
The company also said that Carl Boecher, currently the company's vice president of sales and marketing, will assume the position of president.

"I feel that, while it will not be easy, Datakey's new product strategy will provide growth opportunities it has not had for some time," Underwood said in a news release. "After almost 14 years, it is time for someone else to lead the charge."

Gary Holland, chairman of the board of the electronic products and services company, said Boecher has been heavily involved in developing the product and marketing strategies for the company's secure information products.
